Results.ReviewText: I’ve had Webber kettles for over 40 years and they never disappoint. This is my first premium model and I really like the ash catcher and thermometer. It is an excellent value for the price. I would recommend this to the novice and the experienced griller.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product. Very happy with the purchase Super easy to use
Results.Title: BBQ Webber

Results.ReviewText: Muy buen asador, el color es muy bonito y su funcion en asar maravilloso. controlas el calor, fuego y temperatura, muy facil de limpiar, estoy muy contento.
Results.Title: Muy buen producto.

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback regarding the Original Kettle Premium. We will be sure to share your comments with our team for consideration. If there is anything you need please reach out direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: It does what it is supposed to do. This is my second Weber kettle grill in over 20 years. In that time Weber has done nothing to improve the stability of the leg and wheel assembly. I bought this grill again because of the price point. Probably should have looked at something else and spent some more money.
Results.Title: So-So

Results.ReviewText: I really like this 22” premium kettle. I’ve grilled and smoked. I can’t believe it’s so versatile. No regrets on this purchase at all.
Results.Title: I Really love this grill.

Results.ReviewText: I've had many bbq before and none compare to the quality.
Results.Title: Great quality

Results.ReviewText: It was easy to assemble and works very well. The classic charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Fantastic grill

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us. We are sorry to hear about the fit issues you are having with your grill. Our Care Team will follow up to make sure this has been resolved. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: The top of the grill does not fit tight so I had to reuse the top of my old grill. With out a tight fit it is hard to control the grill temps.
Results.Title: Grill top

Results.ReviewText: Have had Weber Charcoal Grills for over 45 years.   Not disappointed with my new grill.  Like to cook with only charcoal and when our 25 year old Weber wore out, we bought a new one.  Very happy with it so far.
Results.Title: Repeat user

Results.ReviewText: Much improved from my old Weber, which while it had a big reputation was flimsy and cheaply built.
Results.Title: Finally a Weber grill worth the money

Results.ReviewText: I'm really happy with my Weber.  It's real easy to use and I've been really pleased the tasty food I've grilled on it.  I look forward to taking advantage of its versatility to cook all sorts of food.
Results.Title: Easy to use and versatile too!

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for my patio, happy to be back to charcoal grilling and loving the color selection
Results.Title: north country griller

Photos.Caption: I bought a thicker grill plate to get better grill marks

Results.ReviewText:
I bought a new Weber grill because during my move I gave mine away.  I was craving the flavor of a charcoal grilled food like a nice juicy steak.  I own a Weber Genesis II gas grill although good it just doesn’t have the same flavor as charcoal.  I am very happy I purchased this grill because the one I gave away was the original model and not the premium.  I guess it was meant to be because I never gave away my Weber charcoal chimney!  

The premium model is fantastic!  It was easy to put together and made very sturdy.  The ash catcher is definitely better than the original model which only has the plate.  The 22” surface area is a perfect size to cook on where I can have a hot spot and a resting area.  I highly recommend this product.
Results.Title: Missed My Weber Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I’ve had one of these for almost 25 years and I absolutely love it.I just bought another one for our second home. Some minor design improvements have made it even better: The ash catcher is much easier to remove and reinstall, the hanger clip inside the lid work great ( the old one would slip off.). Temperature gauge has been added to the lid, and the lid handle design stays cool. 
And it’s not just a great grill, it’s a decent smoker as well, I do bbq ribs one a year.
Results.Title: Outstanding

Results.ReviewText: Am very happy with my Weber grill.  It was easy to put together.  Really like the ash catcher, had a Weber grill years ago with just the tray, but the ash catcher is much better and doesn't have to be emptied every time I grill.  The size works very well for us, just two of us.  I did buy the Weber Char-Baskets which make indirect grilling a lot easier.  Had a gas grill but went back to the Weber, can't beat the taste of a steak done on charcoal.
Results.Title: Great Grilling

Results.ReviewText: I like the quality of the grill, overall, but the lid could fit onto the grill easier. It's very finicky with placement.
Results.Title: Nice, heavy grill

Results.ReviewText: Love my weber grill. Simple,durable, and easy to use.
Results.Title: Oh Weber

Results.ReviewText:
Great product!  Nostalgia in its own right!  Everything about this grill reminds me of cookouts with my dad and grandfather.  It works perfectly!  
There is only one design element that is slightly disappointing… that would be the lid catch, used to hold the lid in an open position… it is cumbersome at best.  It works, but only if you catch it just right.  It seems that Weber could make the smallest of modifications, and find improvement where very little is needed.
Fantastic purchase overall!
Results.Title: Excellent product with a timeless design

Results.ReviewText: I have been using the original Kettle for about a month now to indirectly grill chicken and burgers. And the end results have been delicious.
Results.Title: Original Kettle is remarkable

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us. We are sorry to hear the handle has broken. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we are here to get you back to grilling. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Been a good grill however it's only 2 years old and the handle fell off when we were grilling.  Both screws fell off the handle at the same time.
Results.Title: Check it before you grill

Results.ReviewText: Already have a pellet smoker with a side gas burner and flat top attachment. Wanted something to chargrille food on and tgis Webber Kettle fit the bill.
Results.Title: Chargrilled Steaks and Burgers

Results.ReviewText: Well made grill, it allows you to easily control how much heat you want to use. It has enough grilling space. It is easy to clean. Also easy to assemble
Results.Title: Perfect grill overall

Results.ReviewText: When I was 25 and bought a house, I went grill shopping. I was looking at the Weber kettle when a guy in his late 50s came by and grabbed one. I asked him about it, and he said buy it, it’s the best and he’s owned five of them. For a moment I asked myself how good it could be if he had to buy five of them, but he was so enthusiastic, I bought it. Grilled a steak that night and immediately understood. And now I’ve just bought my fifth Weber kettle, and am returning the favor when I tell you to buy it, it’s the best.
Results.Title: Best cooking method ever

Results.ReviewText: Good quality. Easy to use. Not the easiest to roll with the small wheels. The lid hook is useful but a little tricky to use.
Results.Title: Happy with purchase

Results.ReviewText: I'm a huge fan of the Kettle Premium grill. It is easy to use and clean, holds heat well, and makes great food. I use it multiple times a week!
Results.Title: Great charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Plenty of big to feed my family of five! Can’t beat the flavor of these grills.
Results.Title: Absolutely Fantatsic

Results.ReviewText: My family has had Weber grills as far back as I can remember! I just had to retire my 30 year old Genesis grill, and I still have a Spirit grill, and now I have my Kettle grill.
Results.Title: My 5 star review

Results.ReviewText: Of course it works like all Weber charcoal grills. It looks nice and all that. To me, the quality isn't quite what it used to be. For instance, the lid on mine doesn't quite fit like my old 22" Performer. If I don't get it set on there quite right, it won't stay on. It will slide right off. I do like the way the ash catcher attaches to the grill. This is new to me. My old grill had the turn style ash catcher.
Results.Title: It's a Weber

Results.ReviewText: When looking for a new charcoal grill I decided to just go back to the gold standard. I had tried before to go cheap and that grill didn’t last. This grill is still same standards as my dad had when I was a kid and theee is a reason why it hasn’t changed. The body is built like a tank to hold up. Quality paint and parts that fit. Fit and finish is great, paint on the kettle is flawless. It came well packaged to avoid damage during shipping.
Results.Title: Trusted quality

Results.ReviewText: After many years with no charcoal grill we purchased the Weber Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22 inch.  We are happy with the grill and the way it performs.  Quality product!
Results.Title: Quality Product

Results.ReviewText: Just a great grill. Gets very hot for steaks and can control low temps for smoking. Just a a plus grill for sure.
Results.Title: Awesome grill!!!

Results.ReviewText: It's a fantastic grill I haven't used in years! Quality built and worth every penny.  I've used it a few time in the past month and am extremely happy with my purchase.
Results.Title: Quality Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: My husband loves this grill! The grates that fold up to allow him to add charcoal if needed are one of the best features. It is easy to maintain a specific temperature and the overall quality is great!
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: It's awesome! It cooks my BBQ food amazingly well and easy to maintain the temp.
Results.Title: Best medium size grill

Results.ReviewText: Beautiful, high-quality grill. Very easy to use. Shipped quickly, easy to assemble.
Results.Title: I love my Weber Copper Kettle!

Results.ReviewText: Only reason i didn't put 5 stars was its a short grill. I can make do, but as a 6'3 man it is short. Other than that i love this grill.
Results.Title: Love it favorite charcoal grill. Is short though.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
